key_idea: Waiting never helps, so each unit fires as early as possible and the kill time is (ceil(h_opp/d)-1)*t (+0.5); compare the two times.
sketch: Unit i needs ceil(h_other/d_i) missiles, fired at times 0, t, 2t, ..., so the opponent dies at (shots-1)*t_i + 0.5. The smaller kill time wins; equal times give a draw because both final missiles are already in the air. Since launch times are integers and flight time is 0.5, a strictly later final launch can never still be fired before the shooter dies, so no other interleaving matters. O(1) with integer arithmetic only.
